name: Sculpfun E1
tagline: Sculpfun's enclosed CoreXY diode line: 12W E1 or 21W E1 Pro, IR module optional
tldr: The Sculpfun E1 line, launched in June 2026, packs a CoreXY gantry, a 400 × 320 mm work area, a built-in camera, an air pump and a honeycomb bed into a Class 1 enclosure. Two diode powers: 12W (E1, $499) and 21W (E1 Pro, $849). Dual bundles add a swappable 3W 1064 nm IR module for metal. Open a power tier for exact specs.
mainObjective: Enclosed diode engraving and wood cutting on a mid-size bed at an open-frame price

priceRange.note: E1 12W $499 to E1 Pro Dual (21W + 3W IR) $1,149 on Sculpfun's store (Oct 2026)

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cut: Basswood & plywood up to 8 mm (12W) or 12 mm (21W), claimed
cannot: Objects taller than 42 mm (30 mm with honeycomb)

pros: Class 1 enclosure with a 400 × 320 mm work area from $499
Camera, air pump and honeycomb bed included in every version
Optional swappable 3W IR module for bare metal
cons: Shallow clearance: 30 mm with the honeycomb
New line: cutting figures are manufacturer claims
beginnerNotes: This overview covers the whole Sculpfun E1 line. Pick the 12W E1 for engraving-first use, the 21W E1 Pro if you cut wood regularly. Take a Dual bundle only if you want bare-metal marking.
proTips: Keep the air pump on for cuts, check focus before each job and vent the exhaust outside or add the SP1 purifier.
primaryUse: Enclosed CoreXY diode laser for home workshops and small businesses.

faq.question: E1 or E1 Pro?
faq.answer: Same enclosure, gantry, camera and bed. The E1 has a 12W diode, the E1 Pro a 21W diode for faster and thicker cuts, for $350 more.

faq.question: What does the Dual version add?
faq.answer: A 3W 1064 nm infrared module that swaps with the diode head to mark bare metals and plastics. It is also sold separately for $499.
